resources.string: After every car start BYDMate+ switches automatic emergency braking off once, as soon as the car is below 10 km/h. Switching AEB back on in the car menu holds until the next start.

AEB (automatic emergency braking) brakes the car by itself before a collision. With it kept off, the car will not brake by itself when a collision is imminent.\n\nYou are responsible for driving safely without AEB, including when someone else drives.
Telegram reports show tire pressure in psi with one decimal instead of bar.
